title: Driving an old Austin in the South of France
author: Les Caramagnols
excerpt: An old Austin outing in the South needs planning around heat, hills, traffic, stops and the car condition.
content:
An outing in an old Austin in the South of France is not prepared like a modern trip. Heat, slow traffic, hilly roads, tight villages and frequent stops put different demands on the car. A well-maintained car makes the drive pleasant; a neglected one quickly becomes a constraint.

The pleasure is in the pace. An old Austin is better suited to flowing roads, reasonable distances and chosen stops than to fast main roads or summer queues.

Prepare before driving

The Austin page gives the marque context. Our Mini Mayfair in the Gulf of Saint-Tropez shows that simple link between a small British car and local outings.
